limits: Means are arithmetic means of per-request throughput, with first warm-up excluded.
Repeated synthetic inputs favor warm PLE row caching and are not a cold-document PLE benchmark.
Approximate decode telemetry windows use host request start plus engine prefill time; sampling is 0.5 s.
The 260K arm checks retrieval and capacity with a short answer, not sustained full-context decode.
The MTP arm uses a different split/prefill configuration and is functional validation only.
